en: Illustrated color postcard depicting a sunlit town square bordered by historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and a central column or monument. In the background on a hill stands a prominent clock tower. Two figures in light clothing walk near the monument, and trees add greenery to the scene. The word "GRAZ" appears at the top, and "KARMEITERPLATZ" (likely intended as Karmeliterplatz) is printed at the bottom. Handwritten script in German fills the right margin and lower edge, including a date notation along the top right.
